title: Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir's Mother's Advice about Joking with Boys
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)
text_original: عن محمد بن المنكدر قال: قالت لي أمي: «لا تمازح الصبيان فتهون عليهم».
text_simplified: Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir reported that his mother discouraged him from joking with boys, fearing that they would think less of him. The advice is attributed to his mother in this account.

review_defects.why: نهته means she forbade him, which is stronger than 'discouraged'.
The Arabic نهته conveys forbidding or prohibiting, which is stronger than 'discouraged'.
